description: The K=16 packed-word coordinate with activation word 7 as a sampled Input gate (IR E): its value is outgoing and the lowering pins it (expected = the committed BF16 word) at its packed position. In the format-3 lowering the pinned word stays a single position -- a range never carries a pin -- while the unpinned activation words split into two ranges around it ([0,7) and [8,16)) and the weight row is one range of 16; the format-3 statement expands to the format-2 one, and the same format-3 witness authenticates under both.
